interpretation: Exploratory cross-validated eta-only ideal-direction diagnostic: calibration family selected after full raw inspection; raw study remains primary. No held-out recentering, independent-validation, intrinsic reconstructed-resolution, digitization, pileup, multi-TeV or noninferiority claim.

contract.geometry_transition_source: Analytic sampling envelope limits, independent of deposited energies; wheel/support gaps not included. Native role-resolved material scans retained separately.
contract.primary_metadata_note: Physical HEPEvt/truth byte hashes and saved primary tuples are identical. Parent manifests were regenerated at distinct recorded source revisions; bind both known origins separately rather than requiring metadata bytes to coincide.
contract.interpretation: Restored sampling versus original: all controls conditional on frozen matched10k policy; no claimed precision recovery in advance.

fold_assignment.assignment: Sort primary IDs; NumPy default_rng(seed).permutation of sorted positions; five balanced contiguous blocks

raw_comparison_limit: raw_global is descriptive only; no calibrated-vs-raw uncertainty contrast is computed. Inference here compares the two cross-validated models under common refitted secondary-bootstrap weights.

bootstrap.resampling: Shared whole-primary multiplicities across both models/projections; refit every training fold then weighted held-out statistics
bootstrap.undefined_rule: No redraw or deletion: failed gain replicate gives undefined statistics; any undefined bootstrap statistic gives null interval/covariance with its undefined count.
bootstrap.intervals: Pointwise 95% percentile, conditional on calibration family chosen after raw inspection and saved simulation
